meta.title: Daybreak Overture - Croque's Message
meta.description: I will defend Magrasea, and the you who lives in Magrasea.

units.rawText: The others knew you'd be coming back, so they've been preparing a welcome banquet... It's sure been noisy, but I can understand how they feel.
units.displayText: The others knew you'd be coming back, so they've been preparing a welcome banquet... It's sure been noisy, but I can understand how they feel.

spans.text: The others knew you'd be coming back, so they've been preparing a welcome banquet... It's sure been noisy, but I can understand how they feel.

units.rawText: Right, and to deal with a situation like before, I've upgraded the Oasis's defenses again.
units.displayText: Right, and to deal with a situation like before, I've upgraded the Oasis's defenses again.

spans.text: Right, and to deal with a situation like before, I've upgraded the Oasis's defenses again.

units.rawText: So if even a horde of Entropics does show up... Ah, with Persicaria here, chances are we won't have to worry about that.
units.displayText: So if even a horde of Entropics does show up... Ah, with Persicaria here, chances are we won't have to worry about that.

spans.text: So if even a horde of Entropics does show up... Ah, with Persicaria here, chances are we won't have to worry about that.

units.rawText: In any case, you can forget about all of the annoying work weighing on your shoulders, and take a good look around Magrasea now that it's been rebuilt.
units.displayText: In any case, you can forget about all of the annoying work weighing on your shoulders, and take a good look around Magrasea now that it's been rebuilt.

spans.text: In any case, you can forget about all of the annoying work weighing on your shoulders, and take a good look around Magrasea now that it's been rebuilt.

units.rawText: Won't you come along too, Croque?
units.displayText: Won't you come along too, Croque?

spans.text: Won't you come along too, Croque?

units.rawText: A lot of people would like to be along with you, you know. If you'd have me though, I could show you my modified Dirac!
units.displayText: A lot of people would like to be along with you, you know. If you'd have me though, I could show you my modified Dirac!

spans.text: A lot of people would like to be along with you, you know. If you'd have me though, I could show you my modified Dirac!

units.rawText: I've done over both the systems and the exterior! And I asked Banxsy to design a special Prof-themed livery...
units.displayText: I've done over both the systems and the exterior! And I asked Banxsy to design a special Prof-themed livery...

spans.text: I've done over both the systems and the exterior! And I asked Banxsy to design a special Prof-themed livery...

units.rawText: ...Hm? That expression, Professor... are you not interested?
units.displayText: ...Hm? That expression, Professor... are you not interested?

spans.text: ...Hm? That expression, Professor... are you not interested?

units.rawText: Pfft... I am, Croque. Lead the way.
units.displayText: Pfft... I am, Croque. Lead the way.

spans.text: Pfft... I am, Croque. Lead the way.

units.rawText: Right, there's one thing I forgot to say.
units.displayText: Right, there's one thing I forgot to say.

spans.text: Right, there's one thing I forgot to say.

units.rawText: After you left, as it turns out, I realized that I hate being lonely. Don't like goodbyes much, either.
units.displayText: After you left, as it turns out, I realized that I hate being lonely. Don't like goodbyes much, either.

spans.text: After you left, as it turns out, I realized that I hate being lonely. Don't like goodbyes much, either.

units.rawText: Professor... please, stay with everyone... stay with me.
units.displayText: Professor... please, stay with everyone... stay with me.

spans.text: Professor... please, stay with everyone... stay with me.
